builds.name: Reference: Armor and control
builds.goal: Reference for Malphite: establish a repeatable reference
builds.hypothesis: An armor-oriented engage tank who disrupts attack carries and uses Q movement theft to remain close. A successful R creates a short window for spells and empowered W attacks. Compare armor-backed tank contact and AP R opening. Do not assume the AP engage lands on multiple targets; real W attacks and E armor scaling require separate measurements. Armor and a real Spellblade attack may preserve close fighting windows.
builds.summary: Armor and a real Spellblade attack may preserve close fighting windows.
testPlan: Kit question for Malphite: Compare armor-backed tank contact and AP R opening. Do not assume the AP engage lands on multiple targets; real W attacks and E armor scaling require separate measurements.

Start with the early core (Iceborn if attack access is useful, otherwise matchup armor) plus appropriate boots at matched gold. Record level, actual ability ranks, forms, resource and item transformations; six-item results do not establish lane strength. Use your intended lane or jungle role; jungle starters and early consumables are outside the final six slots.

Use this as the control for the other three routes. Run three repeatable trials of a short trade and a ten-second fight. Record damage actually landed, attacks/casts, misses, remaining resource and survival. Record available/max mana and any transformed mana-item state.

Measure the actual interaction before granting item/rune procs: Armor and a real Spellblade attack may preserve close fighting windows. Test once stationary, then with a moving opponent and a fixed incoming damage pattern.

Q evidence: Malphite sends a shard of the earth through the ground at his foe, dealing damage upon impact and stealing Move Speed for 3 seconds. Keep finite champion/item/rune stacks explicit. Use Practice Tool, a custom match or your own replay; no numerical adapter is available for this champion.
failureConditions: Do not add another Spellblade item; Thornmail and Randuin are conditional purchases.

The route fails Malphite's stated kit question: Compare armor-backed tank contact and AP R opening. Do not assume the AP engage lands on multiple targets; real W attacks and E armor scaling require separate measurements.
Higher dummy damage is offset by fewer landed actions, deaths before the useful window, or worse ally utility.
tradeoffs: Do not add another Spellblade item; Thornmail and Randuin are conditional purchases.
Full cost 14,750 gold; delayed items, resource starvation and the two-item spike must be judged separately.
The reference is a research control, not a claim of the current highest-win-rate build.
buyOrder: Iceborn if attack access is useful, otherwise matchup armor. Adapt component timing to lane/jungle pressure; do not blindly follow the displayed six-item order.
Keep appropriate boots while building the early core; swap boots only when the measured matchup justifies it.
Thornmail, Randuin's Omen, Spirit Visage are later or conditional slots; do not postpone necessary protection for a six-item ceiling.
Record available/max mana and any transformed mana-item state.
coverageNotes: No numerical damage or survival adapter exists for this champion. Loading this proposal opens a manual test sheet, not calculated damage.
Source formulas remain in Champion kit. Symbolic values, unresolved tokens and helper records are evidence to inspect, not a certified executable simulator.
Legal source item/rune references were checked; retained map flags cannot prove every live-shop condition. Confirm shop eligibility, exact on-hit/on-attack rules and real proc cooldowns in game.

builds.name: Armor aftershock boxer
builds.summary: Test armor aftershock boxer against conventional damage at equal gold.
builds.goal: Test armor aftershock boxer against conventional damage at equal gold.
builds.hypothesis: Thunderclap's attack and five-second aftershocks scale with 0.15 armor as physical damage, while Ground Slam scales 0.4 armor as magic. Iceborn adds physical Spellblade and a slow zone; Terminus helps mixed attack damage if Malphite can remain in melee.
testPlan: Required state: Granite Shield active for the larger passive armor multiplier.
Measure W attacks and E before and after shield breaks.

Run three trials at matched level, ranks, gold and target defenses. Repeat against a moving opponent with a fixed incoming damage pattern. Record damage packets, missed actions, resource cost and survival separately.
Keep souls, health/mana, form, item/rune stacks, transformations and game time finite and explicitly recorded. No free full ramp or infinite scaling.
failureConditions: Magic opponents bypass the armor focus and poke removes the tripled W bonus.
The narrow damage gain does not repay lost access, survival, wave control or allied utility.
tradeoffs: Rejected assumption: Armor does not give AP to Q/R and aftershocks cannot be assumed to crit.
Confidence: plausible. Source-compatible reasoning is not in-game validation or proof of novelty/optimality.
buyOrder: Candidate six slots: Frozen Heart, Iceborn Gauntlet, Sunfire Aegis, Terminus, Spirit Visage, Plated Steelcaps. Compare two-item checkpoints before the final six-slot test; this list is not a lane shopping order.
Keep role-appropriate starters, boots and support quest/vision obligations. If the full candidate assumes farmed income, compare it separately from support income.
coverageNotes: Only Cassiopeia Q/E and Sett W have numerical adapters. Even there, these other objectives and item/rune interactions may fall outside the model.
Proc inheritance, crit, pet hits and conditional helpers remain uncertain until observed. No completed mathematical maximum is claimed.
